blocks.text: “If AI only helps us predict who will have a claim, we have built a better risk model. If it helps us prevent that claim, protect more people, and make insurance more accessible, then we have built a better insurance company.” Insurance has always been built around the promise that when something goes wrong, we are there to support them in their recovery. But what if we could do more than help people pick up the pieces? What if we could assist them to prevent the loss in the first place? In my view, this is a question worth asking as […]...
